Title: ExpressRoute Resource GUID name change from "Port" to "Direct"

Body.Content:
On May 1, 2019, the resource GUID names of Azure ExpressRoute will change. The service type will change from "Port" to "Direct." This will affect the EA portal names as well. See the following table for details.
